"""Open loop trajectory for the frozen MolmoSpaces door episode."""
import numpy as np
from rcb_molmospaces import Session

INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"

s = Session(INSTANCE)
q0 = s.proprio()["joint_pos"].copy()
pose_r = s.proprio()["tcp_pose"][7:].copy()
# Approach the door handle from the initial robot pose.
target = [8.55, 8.72, 1.02, *pose_r[3:]]
ik = s.kinematics({"op": "ik", "targets": {"right_gripper": target}, "seed": q0})
assert ik["ok"], ik
q1 = np.asarray(ik["q"], dtype=float)
row0 = np.asarray(s.hold_row(), dtype=float)
rows = []
for k in range(1, 26):
    f = min(1., k / 20.)
    row = row0.copy()
    row[:23] = q0 + f * (q1 - q0)
    row[23:] = 0.
    rows.append(row)
# Keep the approached pose steady for inspection/contact settling.
for _ in range(5):
    rows.append(rows[-1].copy())
rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float64)
s.save_trajectory(rows, OUT)
print("saved", rows.shape, "IK", ik["error"])
if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("status", s.replay(rows))
    print("door", s.state()["joints"]["doorway_06578a8f61a612b28999ce2f14b6e2c7_1_2_2_doorwaydoor7joint0_0"])
    from PIL import Image
    Image.fromarray(s.render("head_camera")).save("/app/output/approach_head.png")
    Image.fromarray(s.render("wrist_camera_r")).save("/app/output/approach_wrist.png")
